body: T11 RESPEC - Score animation spec (original sent to GA 20260222-1016). ORIGINAL PROBLEM: My original score animation spec had prose in the Behavior section. 'The score should animate smoothly' is not a spec. GA had to guess duration, easing, and reduced-motion behavior. RESPEC USING T12 RULES (no prose in Behavior): PROBLEM: Score appears instantly after gradeExam() runs. No visual transition. Kai does not know the UI has changed state. BEHAVIOR: On gradeExam() completion, score section transitions from display:none to opacity:1 over exactly 600ms. CSS: transition: opacity 600ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). Implementation: set opacity:0 visibility:hidden before display, then rAF to add .score-visible class. STATES: pre-submit (hidden, opacity:0), revealing (opacity animating 0 to 1), complete (opacity:1 visible). EDGE CASES: if gradeExam() throws error, score-visible class not added, section stays hidden. If reduced-motion: no transition, set opacity:1 directly. ACCEPT CRITERIA: 600ms exactly (measured in DevTools); cubic-bezier matches spec; reduced-motion: instant; no flash of unstyled content. WHAT CHANGED: duration is now 600ms not 500ms (was ambiguous). reduced-motion is now specified. easing is now a specific bezier not smooth.
